description.es: Superficie continua deformada por la posición del cursor. Combina ondas radiales y ruido procedural.
description.en: Continuous surface deformed by cursor position. Combines radial ripples with procedural noise.
description.zh: 由光标位置驱动的连续表面变形。结合径向波纹与程序化噪声。

frag: void main(){ vec2 uv=vUv; float dist=length(uv-uMouse); float ripple=sin(dist*18.0-uTime*4.0)*exp(-dist*6.0)*uHover; float n=snoise(uv*3.0+uTime*0.4)*0.5; float disp=ripple+n*0.15; vec3 col=mix(vec3(0.04,0.12,0.06), uAccent, clamp(disp+0.5,0.0,1.0)); gl_FragColor=vec4(col,1.0); }

description.es: Particionado de Voronoi animado. El hover desplaza la paleta y resalta los bordes celulares.
description.en: Animated Voronoi partitioning. Hover shifts the palette and highlights the cell edges.
description.zh: 动画化的 Voronoi 分割。悬停时移动调色板并突出单元边缘。

frag: vec2 h2(vec2 p){ p=vec2(dot(p,vec2(127.1,311.7)),dot(p,vec2(269.5,183.3))); return fract(sin(p)*43758.5453); } void main(){ vec2 uv=vUv*4.0; vec2 g=floor(uv); vec2 f=fract(uv); float md=8.0; vec2 mp=vec2(0.0); for(int j=-1;j<=1;j++)for(int i=-1;i<=1;i++){ vec2 o=vec2(float(i),float(j)); vec2 r=h2(g+o); r=0.5+0.5*sin(uTime*0.8+6.2831*r); vec2 d=o+r-f; float dd=dot(d,d); if(dd<md){ md=dd; mp=g+o+r; } } float edge=sqrt(md); vec3 base=mix(vec3(0.02,0.05,0.03), uAccent, fract(mp.x*0.3+mp.y*0.2+uHover*0.5)); base=mix(base, vec3(0.9,0.95,1.0), smoothstep(0.06,0.0,edge)*uHover); gl_FragColor=vec4(base*(0.35+0.65*edge),1.0); }

description.es: Líneas isocontorno extraídas de un campo de ruido fractal en movimiento.
description.en: Isocontour lines extracted from a moving fractal noise field.
description.zh: 从移动的分形噪声场提取的等值线。

frag: void main(){ vec2 uv=vUv*3.0; float n=fbm(uv+uTime*0.15+uMouse*uHover*2.0); float lines=abs(fract(n*8.0)-0.5); float c=smoothstep(0.07,0.0,lines); vec3 col=mix(vec3(0.02,0.04,0.03), uAccent, c); gl_FragColor=vec4(col,1.0); }

hint.es: las letras se licuan en hover

description.es: Letras construidas con SDF y disueltas con curl-noise en función del hover.
description.en: Letters built from signed distance fields, dissolved by curl-noise under hover.
description.zh: 用符号距离场构建的字母，在悬停时被旋度噪声打散。

frag: float sdSeg(vec2 p, vec2 a, vec2 b){ vec2 pa=p-a, ba=b-a; float h=clamp(dot(pa,ba)/dot(ba,ba),0.0,1.0); return length(pa-ba*h); } void main(){ vec2 uv=(vUv-0.5)*2.0; uv.x*=uRes.x/uRes.y; uv+=curl(uv*2.0+uTime)*uHover*0.22; float d=8.0; d=min(d, sdSeg(uv, vec2(-0.12,0.35), vec2(-0.12,-0.35))); d=min(d, sdSeg(uv, vec2(-0.12,-0.35), vec2(0.28,-0.35))); float shape=smoothstep(0.07,0.02,d); vec3 col=mix(vec3(0.02,0.03,0.02), uAccent, shape); gl_FragColor=vec4(col,1.0); }

description.es: 150k pseudo-partículas guiadas por curl-noise. El cursor las concentra en una nube luminosa.
description.en: 150k pseudo-particles steered by curl-noise. The cursor concentrates them into a luminous cloud.
description.zh: 由旋度噪声驱动的 15 万颗伪粒子。光标将它们凝聚成发光的云。

frag: void main(){ vec2 uv=vUv; vec2 p=uv*7.0; vec2 fl=curl(p*0.5+uTime*0.25); p+=fl*0.7; vec2 gp=fract(p)-0.5; vec2 id=floor(p); float r=length(gp); float rnd=fract(sin(dot(id,vec2(12.9,78.2)))*43758.5); float dots=smoothstep(0.2,0.0,r)*(0.35+0.65*rnd); vec3 col=mix(vec3(0.01,0.03,0.02), uAccent, dots); float md=length(uv-uMouse); col+=uAccent*exp(-md*5.0)*uHover*0.6; gl_FragColor=vec4(col,1.0); }

description.es: Esfera con aberración cromática modulada por el hover. Iluminación direccional simple.
description.en: Sphere with chromatic aberration modulated by hover. Simple directional lighting.
description.zh: 受悬停调制的色差球体。简单的方向光照。

frag: void main(){ vec2 uv=(vUv-0.5)*2.0; uv.x*=uRes.x/uRes.y; float r=length(uv); float sphere=smoothstep(0.62,0.6,r); vec3 nrm=vec3(uv, sqrt(max(0.0,0.36-r*r))); float light=clamp(dot(normalize(nrm), normalize(vec3(0.5,0.6,0.9))),0.0,1.0); float ab=0.02+uHover*0.06; float cr=smoothstep(0.62,0.6,length(uv*(1.0+ab))); float cb=smoothstep(0.62,0.6,length(uv*(1.0-ab))); vec3 col=vec3(cr,sphere,cb)*0.35 + uAccent*pow(light,1.5)*sphere*0.9; col+=uAccent*pow(light,8.0)*0.4*sphere; gl_FragColor=vec4(col,1.0); }

hint.zh: 点击 + 拖动以固定 / 释放

description.es: Malla de tela colgante que reacciona al cursor como viento localizado. Iluminación dinámica por normales de la malla.
description.en: Hanging cloth mesh reacting to the cursor as localised wind. Dynamic lighting from mesh normals.
description.zh: 悬挂的布料网格，将光标作为局部风源，并由网格法线驱动动态光照。

frag: void main(){ vec2 uv=vUv; float wave=sin(uv.x*14.0 + uTime*1.4)*0.04 + cos(uv.y*10.0 - uTime*1.1)*0.03; vec2 m=uMouse; float md=length(uv-m); float wind=exp(-md*4.0)*uHover*0.18; float y=uv.y + wave + wind*sin(uv.x*22.0+uTime*3.0); float n=fbm(uv*4.0+vec2(0.0,uTime*0.2))*0.5; vec3 nrm=normalize(vec3(dFdx(y)*40.0, 1.0, dFdy(y)*40.0)); float light=clamp(dot(nrm, normalize(vec3(0.4,0.8,0.3))),0.0,1.0); float fold=smoothstep(0.0,1.0,abs(fract(y*8.0)-0.5)*2.0); vec3 base=mix(vec3(0.03,0.06,0.05), uAccent*0.9, fold*0.8 + light*0.5 + n*0.2); base+=uAccent*wind*1.2; gl_FragColor=vec4(base,1.0); }

description.es: Partículas con colisiones elásticas. El cursor actúa como obstáculo sólido. Color por velocidad (mapa de calor).
description.en: Elastically colliding particles. The cursor is a solid obstacle. Heatmap colour by velocity.
description.zh: 弹性碰撞粒子。光标是固体障碍。颜色按速度形成热力图。

frag: vec3 heat(float t){ return mix(mix(vec3(0.04,0.02,0.10), vec3(0.92,0.32,0.18), smoothstep(0.0,0.6,t)), vec3(1.0,0.95,0.55), smoothstep(0.6,1.0,t)); } void main(){ vec2 uv=vUv; vec2 p=uv*9.0; vec2 fl=curl(p*0.4+uTime*0.5)*1.4; p+=fl; vec2 gp=fract(p)-0.5; vec2 id=floor(p); float r=length(gp); float rnd=fract(sin(dot(id,vec2(91.1,47.7)))*43758.5); float speed=length(fl)*0.6 + rnd*0.4; float md=length(uv-uMouse); float push=smoothstep(0.18,0.0,md)*uHover; speed+=push*1.2; float disk=smoothstep(0.22,0.05,r); vec3 col=heat(clamp(speed,0.0,1.0))*disk; col=mix(col, vec3(0.0), smoothstep(0.12,0.06,md)*uHover); gl_FragColor=vec4(col,1.0); }

hint.es: hover rota · click cambia la forma
hint.zh: 悬停旋转 · 点击切换形状

description.es: SDF raymarching de un cristal geométrico. Hover rota la cámara. Click cambia entre octaedro → dodecaedro → icosaedro. Refracción y reflexión interna con IOR ajustable.
description.en: SDF raymarching of a geometric crystal. Hover rotates the camera. Click cycles octahedron → dodecahedron → icosahedron. Refraction and internal reflection with adjustable IOR.
description.zh: 几何晶体的 SDF 光线步进。悬停旋转相机。点击在八面体 → 十二面体 → 二十面体之间切换。可调折射率与内部反射。

frag: mat2 rot(float a){ float c=cos(a),s=sin(a); return mat2(c,-s,s,c); } float sdOct(vec3 p, float s){ p=abs(p); return (p.x+p.y+p.z-s)*0.57735027; } float sdf(vec3 p){ p.xz=rot(uTime*0.4+uMouse.x*3.14*uHover)*p.xz; p.xy=rot(uTime*0.3+uMouse.y*3.14*uHover)*p.xy; float o=sdOct(p,1.0); float ic=length(p)-1.05; return mix(o,ic,0.35); } vec3 nrm(vec3 p){ float e=0.001; return normalize(vec3( sdf(p+vec3(e,0,0))-sdf(p-vec3(e,0,0)), sdf(p+vec3(0,e,0))-sdf(p-vec3(0,e,0)), sdf(p+vec3(0,0,e))-sdf(p-vec3(0,0,e)) )); } void main(){ vec2 uv=(vUv-0.5)*2.0; uv.x*=uRes.x/uRes.y; vec3 ro=vec3(0.0,0.0,-3.2); vec3 rd=normalize(vec3(uv,1.6)); float t=0.0; float hit=-1.0; for(int i=0;i<48;i++){ vec3 p=ro+rd*t; float d=sdf(p); if(d<0.002){ hit=t; break; } t+=d*0.9; if(t>8.0) break; } vec3 col=vec3(0.02,0.04,0.03); if(hit>0.0){ vec3 p=ro+rd*hit; vec3 n=nrm(p); float fres=pow(1.0-clamp(dot(-rd,n),0.0,1.0),3.0); vec3 refr=refract(rd,n,1.0/1.45); float inside=fbm(refr.xy*2.0+uTime*0.2); col=mix(uAccent*0.6, vec3(0.85,0.95,1.0), fres); col+=uAccent*inside*0.4; float spec=pow(max(dot(reflect(rd,n), normalize(vec3(0.4,0.8,0.4))),0.0),32.0); col+=vec3(spec); } gl_FragColor=vec4(col,1.0); }

description.es: Generador de paletas basado en la cosine-palette de Íñigo Quílez. Cuatro variables (a, b, c, d) deforman la curva en tiempo real. Visualización dual: gradiente lineal + rueda cromática.
description.en: Palette generator built on Íñigo Quílez's cosine-palette. Four variables (a, b, c, d) deform the curve in real time. Dual view: linear gradient + chromatic wheel.
description.zh: 基于 Íñigo Quílez 余弦调色板的生成器。四个变量（a、b、c、d）实时变形曲线。线性渐变 + 色环双视图。

frag: vec3 pal(float t){ vec3 a=vec3(0.5,0.5,0.5); vec3 b=vec3(0.5,0.5,0.5); vec3 c=vec3(1.0,1.0,1.0); vec3 d=vec3(0.0,0.33,0.67)+vec3(uTime*0.05); return a+b*cos(6.2831*(c*t+d+uMouse.x*uHover)); } void main(){ vec2 uv=(vUv-0.5)*2.0; uv.x*=uRes.x/uRes.y; float r=length(uv); float wheel=smoothstep(0.85,0.83,r)*smoothstep(0.45,0.47,r); float ang=atan(uv.y,uv.x)/6.2831+0.5; float bar=smoothstep(0.05,0.0,abs(uv.y+0.55)); vec3 wcol=pal(ang); vec3 bcol=pal(uv.x*0.5+0.5); vec3 col=vec3(0.02,0.03,0.03); col=mix(col, wcol, wheel); col=mix(col, bcol, bar); float ring=smoothstep(0.02,0.0,abs(r-(0.45+0.4*fract(uTime*0.2)))); col+=uAccent*ring*0.2*uHover; gl_FragColor=vec4(col,1.0); }

description.es: Canvas WebGL 2D donde el cursor pinta normal maps. Brush con radio, dureza y dirección Z. Preview en vivo con esfera iluminada usando el normal map pintado. Reset / export PNG.
description.en: WebGL 2D canvas where the cursor paints normal maps. Brush with radius, hardness and Z direction. Live preview on a sphere lit by the painted normal map. Reset / export PNG.
description.zh: 在 WebGL 2D 画布上用光标绘制法线贴图。可调笔刷半径、硬度与 Z 方向。在被绘制法线照亮的球体上实时预览。可重置 / 导出 PNG。

frag: void main(){ vec2 uv=vUv; vec2 m=uMouse; float md=length(uv-m); float stroke=smoothstep(0.12,0.0,md)*uHover; float trail=smoothstep(0.32,0.05,length(uv-vec2(0.5)+vec2(sin(uTime*0.4),cos(uTime*0.3))*0.18)); float n=fbm(uv*6.0+uTime*0.2); vec3 nrm=normalize(vec3((n-0.5)*1.2, (fbm(uv*6.0+10.0)-0.5)*1.2, 0.8)); vec3 light=normalize(vec3(0.4+sin(uTime)*0.2, 0.6, 0.7)); float lit=clamp(dot(nrm,light),0.0,1.0); vec3 base=vec3(0.04,0.05,0.05); vec3 surf=mix(base, uAccent*0.85, lit*0.9 + trail*0.4 + stroke*0.6); float grid=smoothstep(0.02,0.0,abs(fract(uv.x*16.0)-0.5)) + smoothstep(0.02,0.0,abs(fract(uv.y*16.0)-0.5)); surf+=vec3(0.05)*grid*0.3; gl_FragColor=vec4(surf,1.0); }
